added_failure_derivation: The reviewed node's suite arms were not armed: verify-gate.json records 'the scoped-gate arm resolves to no command at aaf0f00d4017d810055cf9175f1fb3bb717a06ae', and the manifest carries no baseline_suite/after_suite JSON. There is therefore no suite pair to difference; the count is 0 because no arm exists, not because a pair was read and found equal.

findings.text: diamagnetic_fluxes returns the dedicated diamagnetic_flux rows early (if channels: return tuple(channels)) and never appends the diamagnetic-labelled flux_loop channels, contradicting its own docstring that the loop form is read second; an entry publishing both silently loses the loop channels, and a caller selecting one by name raises 'diamagnetic channels not found' for a channel that exists.

require_b0_like_sign recomputes the sense logic already in b0_like_sense (lines 78-104) instead of deriving one from the other; the two can diverge, since one returns None for a sign-changing field and the other raises, so the predicate and the guard are not required to agree.

DIAMAGNETIC_FLUX_NAME hard-codes the standard name 'diamagnetic_flux' and writes it as standard_name without checking the Catalog: StandardNameResolver.resolve('diamagnetic_flux') reports provisional=True, and nova/io/ingest.py's contract is to namespace such a name as provisional/ and flag it, so the store row claims a catalog name the resolver says is not in the catalog.

diamagnetic_flux_dataset assembles an xarray.Dataset with source/units/cocos/calibration/provenance attributes for SignalStore.write, which is the capability IdsIngest.tensorize already owns; the addition does not extend or call that owner, so the attributed-dataset assembly is duplicated rather than shared (the sign verification and channel selection are the only genuinely new capabilities).

The MAST census that stands in for done_when (2) under the plan's lead ruling has no committed script or command header: its 131/9,981/713 and 178/179 counts are reproducible only by rewriting the scan, and the WEST table at line 14 has no log at all, so no reader can re-derive either number set from the tree.

The manifest's negative_control_log records a failure at tests/test_diamagnetic_flux_reader.py:114, a path renamed to this file in commit aaf0f00d4; the red log therefore cites a file absent at the reviewed head, so its provenance is stale even though the guard it demonstrates is exercised by the identically named test here.
